messages:
Incident Bot: ⚠️ ALERT triggered: inference-api.p99 latency = 1.82s (SLO 500ms)
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-78901 — page fired to on-call schedule 'eng-oncall'
PagerDuty: PD-78901 — Triggered by alert rule 'latency-p99-slo-burn' — auto-escalation in 8m if unacked
Micah: acked PD-78901 :thumbsup: — taking first responder
Micah: quick snapshot from Wavefront -> https://dash.wavefront.prod/redwood/inference-api?range=5m : p50~60ms, p95~420ms, p99~1.8s; error rates stable
Micah: hypothesis — tail tokens or a model rollout causing KV cache misses; checking recent deploys
Raj: I see a canary deployment to model-v4 completed ~2m before alert. Rolling logtail...
Anya: ops-bot: post runbook link please
ops-bot: Runbook for high-tail-latency: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/high-tail-latency — steps: validate, throttle, fallback-model, scale, rollback
Micah: Running quick check: kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gpu -> a few nodes at 98% GPU mem
Micah: curl -s https://canary.logs.prod/model-v4 | tail -n 60
Micah: ```
2026-03-15T14:01:02Z INFO model-v4 init complete
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z WARN kvcache: miss rate increased 18% -> 62%
2026-03-15T14:03:40Z ERROR request 0x9af3 slow_token_fetch
```
Micah: kvcache miss spike lines up with canary rollout timestamp
Raj: Oncall action plan: 1) throttle large-batch requests 2) enable fallback to model-v3 for latency-sensitive routes 3) scale up dedicated-gpu pool by +2 nodes 4) if still high, rollback model-v4 canary
Anya: I'm patching routing rule now to route traffic.beta -> model-v3 for /v1/generate?latency_hint=low
Anya: ```splunk
POST /routing/update {"route":"/v1/generate","model_preference":["model-v3","model-v4"]}
```
Anya: applied, confirming traffic shift metrics
Micah: ops-bot: trigger autoscale +2 on pool 'dedicated-gpu-prod' for 15m
ops-bot: Autoscale request submitted: action_id=asc-3321
Sara: PD note: notifying CSMs & support to hold on-messages for customers in EU/NA — visible degradation for some customers
Micah: after route flip + autoscale: p99 dropped to 720ms in 90s, p95 ~430ms — still above SLO but much improved
Micah: canary model-v4 still getting ~10% traffic due to sticky sessions; we should fully cut it before considering rollback
Raj: I'll force-evict sticky KV entries for canary sessions (non-disruptive) and change canary weight to 0
Raj: ```bash
kubectl exec -it kvcache-evictor -- evict --selector=canary=true --confirm
kubectl patch deploy canary-model --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'
```
Micah: canary weight 0 applied. monitoring...
Micah: p99 now at 310ms and p95 380ms — back within acceptable band for now. PD incident: recommend ack -> resolve after stable for 10m
PagerDuty: PD-78901 — Acknowledged by Micah — status: acknowledged
Micah: I'm going to leave the autoscale +2 running for 20m then ramp down. Opening a follow-up ticket to revert routing after deeper bake
Anya: created ticket INF-4523: "Investigate model-v4 kvcache regression + safe rollout strategy"
Sara: Customer impact summary: subset of requests (1.7% of total) experienced elevated latency -> small fraction of sessions degraded; no errors or data loss reported. CSMs paged for possible outreach.
Micah: Resolve plan: keep model-v4 paused, add cross-check in release pipeline to run kvcache stress test for new model builds, update rollout to 1% -> 5% -> 20% with metrics gate for kvcache miss rate
Micah: Will resolve PD incident if metrics hold for 10m
Incident Bot: PD-78901 auto-update: status changed to resolved (resolved_by=Micah) — resolution: routing fallback + evict canary + autoscale
Micah: TL;DR: p99 SLO burn from model-v4 causing KV cache thrashing. Immediate mitigation: routing fallback to model-v3 + force evict sticky cache entries + short autoscale. Follow-up: INF-4523 for postmortem and rollout safeguards.
Anya: assigning INF-4523 -> Raj (owner) + Micah (review), due 2026-03-18
Raj: acked. I'll draft postmortem and include loadtest/kvcache regression test snippets.
Sara: Thanks team. Micah — please hand off to next on-call in 30m if you're stepping out.
Micah: Handoff to next oncall @Anya in 30m. Leaving notes in runbook and INF-4523. :white_check_mark:
